name: Full Agent Pipeline
description: Complete agentic pipeline with all 5 specialized loops: Planning → Execution → Evaluation, with Critic watching and Memory compressing.

face.label: Plan
face.sentence: Plan reads your task, Check's verdicts, Critique's notes and Memory's summary, and hands Do the next task.

face.label: Do
face.sentence: Do does the task with its tools and reports what it did.

face.label: Check
face.sentence: Check verifies Do's work: with checks its verdict is theirs, otherwise its model's.

face.label: Critique
face.sentence: Critique reads counts and verdicts, never the work, and notes stagnation and circles.

face.label: Memory
face.sentence: Memory compresses Do's results and Check's verdicts into a summary Do and Plan read.

ways_back.label: not passing: back to Plan
ways_back.when: Check's verdict is not a pass, and Plan starts the next round with it

tool.shell.name: shell
tool.shell.description: Run a shell command in the workspace and return its output. Only these programs run: ls, cat, head, tail, wc, echo, printf, pwd, test, [, true, false, grep, egrep, fgrep, sort, uniq, cut, tr, rev, paste, comm, fold, nl, diff, cmp, file, stat, du, basename, dirname, date, seq, od, md5sum, sha1sum, sha256sum, shasum, find, tee, mkdir, touch, cp, mv, rm, rmdir. No $ expansions, backticks, subshells or here-documents, and no path outside the workspace.
